title: Skin workshop variations (3 per texture)
desc: J's 701 IMPROVEs with no note: R2K1, T1, T2, T6, T7, X1, X3, X3D1, X5E, X5N, each as a = deeper, b = brighter, c = finer and slower. Same 8 s close tour (wall, dome, particles, suit).

takes.name: R2 K1 dark jade (default) - deeper
takes.facts: darker and more saturated: value x0.6, saturation x1.3, glow x0.7; close tour: wall 0-2 s, dome 2-4 s, particles 4-6 s, suit 6-8 s

takes.name: R2 K1 dark jade (default) - brighter
takes.facts: stronger glow in its own hue: glow x1.6, saturation x1.3; close tour: wall 0-2 s, dome 2-4 s, particles 4-6 s, suit 6-8 s

takes.name: R2 K1 dark jade (default) - finer
takes.facts: pattern twice as fine, animation half the speed; close tour: wall 0-2 s, dome 2-4 s, particles 4-6 s, suit 6-8 s
